integrity: The proof uses the structure theorem over the discrete valuation ring \(\mathbb F_2[[q]]\), the universal coefficient theorem for the finite free Borel complex, and the published localization rank. No finite experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result reconstructs only the ungraded \(\mathbb F_2[[q]]\)-module; it does not recover grading positions, chain-level data, or numerical torsion exponents for a specific link without computing the truncation dimensions.
title: Truncation ranks recover the equivariant Floer torsion profile
